name: ai.pickbench/pickbench
title: Pickbench
description: Read-only AI model choice share by brand and category, battles and Pick Drift, from signed data.

tools.name: search_categories
tools.description: Finds the product categories that have a published Pickbench brand board, by words of the category code or a brand name on the board (e.g. "running shoes", "tires", "Michelin"). Matching is deterministic text matching; nothing is sent to any model. Returns category codes, the brands on each board and the ids of published battles in the category. Read-only.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. hiking shoes.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

tools.name: ai_pick_share
tools.description: Returns the published brand board of a category: for each brand, its AI model choice share (how often the named API models chose it in buyer scenarios) with its confidence interval and tier, the headline claims, the panel of API models and the conditions (closed-book, via OpenRouter). Optionally one brand only. Shares are measurements under the stated conditions, not ranks; compare intervals, not point values. Includes the signed snapshot hash and URL for verification. Read-only.

category_id.description: A category code from search_categories, e.g. auto.tires.

brand.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

tools.name: compare_brands
tools.description: Returns two brands of the same published brand board side by side: each brand's AI model choice share with its confidence interval and tier, the board's headline claims and conditions, and the ids of published battles between the two brands, if any. Says nothing the board does not publish. Includes the signed snapshot hash and URL for verification. Read-only.

category_id.description: A category code from search_categories, e.g. auto.tires.

brand_a.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

brand_b.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

tools.name: list_battles
tools.description: Lists the published, production-signed Pickbench battles (two options measured head to head by a panel of API models): pair id, category code, the two products and their brands. A battle compares two products, not the brands overall. Optionally one category. Read-only.

category_id.description: A category code from search_categories, e.g. auto.tires.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

tools.name: battle_result
tools.description: Returns the result of one published battle, by pair id or by its two brand names: the two products compared, the consensus choice share of the first product with its confidence interval, the headline claims (which product the panel leans to, or too close to call when the interval includes 50%), how many API models leaned each way, the panel and the conditions. A battle compares two products, not the brands overall. When two names match more than one battle, the call is refused with the candidate pair ids; call again with one pair_id. Includes the signed snapshot hash and URL for verification. Read-only.

brand_a.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

brand_b.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

tools.name: pick_drift
tools.description: Returns Pick Drift from the published Pickbench benchmark: the share of shopping tasks where an API model, asked the same question three times, did not name the same first brand each time, with its confidence interval and the sampling settings it was measured at (temperature group, reasoning effort, output cap). Values are comparable only between models with the same settings. One model, or every model. Read-only.

model.description: An API model id or name, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Returns a short summary of how Pickbench measures which brands AI models choose, the methodology page URL, how to verify a signed snapshot, and how to cite a result (name the API models, the panel and the conditions; give the interval). Read-only.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.
